text:
alex.h: Quick heads-up: noticed a weird tokenization delta for the new llama-x variant when using our chat template.

maria.g: Details?

alex.h: Repro: system + user + assistant history concatenated -> EOS gets duplicated at template boundary. Causes KV-cache index shift and sometimes a 1-token truncation in responses. Repro snippet below.

alex.h: ```python
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.load('s3://redwood-models/weights/llama-x/v2/tokenizer.json')
seq = t.encode('<|system|>Welcome<eos>' + '<|user|>hi<eos>' + '<|assistant|>')
print(seq)  # expected trailing eos once, got two in the join point
```

jonathan: Is this on hosted infra or local tests?

alex.h: Local dev (commit abc123, docker build). Tokenizer json is from s3://redwood-models/weights/llama-x/v2/tokenizer.json. Also reproduced on a small dedicated dev bucket.

ci-bot: Ran tokenizer-unit-tests: token-boundary-test FAILED (off-by-one). See CI job #9844.

maria.g: Probable cause: our chat template includes an explicit <eos> in the system/user segments while model_manifest has "append_eos": true. So double-append at runtime. Check model_manifest field.

alex.h: Confirmed model_manifest.append_eos = true for llama-x v2. Two quick fixes: strip template trailing <eos> OR set append_eos = false for this variant. Need to decide which keeps compat.

tia: Also saw '<|system|>' token split into two tokens on the new BPE, which shifts token counts in analytics. That might make prompts exceed max_len unexpectedly.

jonathan: We should add unit tests in tokenizer-tests for: (1) system+user join behavior; (2) explicit eos in template vs manifest append. Also an integration test for KV cache offsets on long histories.

alex.h: Draft PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/4123 — includes failing unit and strip-eos-in-chatfmt patch. Leaving TODO for runtime team to confirm KV index logic.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued for model-serving:llama-x-v2 once PR merged and CI green.

maria.g: Quick question — does this affect embeddings or just generation/chat?

alex.h: Only chat/generation/streaming paths (we don't touch embed preprocessing).

jonathan: If we change model_manifest, we need a small migration to update manifests in GCS and Dedicated caches. I'll add a migration script to the PR if we go that route.

cia: (typo) ignore

tia: :thumbsup: I'll add a test case for '<|system|>' token splitting and update prompt-length guardrails in quickstart.

alex.h: Thanks. Timeline proposal: merge fix + tests today, canary tonight, rollback plan if latency/regression observed. Tagging @eng-ml for visibility.

maria.g: :eyes: will review PR within the hour.

jonathan: If anyone from eng-runtime can validate KV cache indexing before merge that'd be great — pinging runtime leads.

alex.h: also added a short note in the model card: "watch out for double-eos when using pre-built chat templates" — can tweak wording in PR.

maria.g: Nice. After merge I'll run a quick sweep over the model catalog to flag other manifests with append_eos=true + chat-templates that include eos.

alex.h: Perfect. Thanks everyone.
